units.source_text: 目前，书仓网提供了在线的电子书刊制作工具，

en.t: At present, Shucang.com provides an online tool for creating electronic books and publications,

units.source_text: 不用下载软件，人们就可以直接制作符合Epub标准的电子书刊，

en.t: without downloading any software, people can directly create electronic books and publications that meet the Epub standard,

units.source_text: 它同时也提供了在线和手机阅读功能，

en.t: it also provides online and mobile reading functions at the same time,

units.source_text: 人们也可以把自己的Epub、Chm、Doc等电子书刊上传，

en.t: people can also upload their own electronic books and publications in formats such as Epub, Chm, and Doc,

units.source_text: 书仓将他们转换为可在线阅读的方式，

en.t: and Shucang converts them into a form that can be read online,

units.source_text: 让你在任何地方都能读取。

en.t: allowing you to read them anywhere.
